Subject: Thornbury Living Communities - Questions for Quote

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Thornbury Living Communities. I have everything I need to move forward and the risk looks good for our appetite.

Before I can finalize a quote, I need some additional information:

- Can you confirm the construction type and year built for each location?
- What fire protection class applies to both properties?
- Are there any life safety systems in place (sprinklers, alarms)?
- Please provide details on occupancy - assisted living, independent living, or mixed?

Once I have these details, I'll work up a competitive quote for the 11/30/26 effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
